tools.name: email_ticket_confirmation
tools.description: Sends an email to the ticket holder with their order confirmation and event details. Does not change the order itself.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order to send the confirmation for

params.name: override_email
params.description: Optional email address to use instead of the one on the order

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import tool

DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"


@dataclass
class ConfirmationResult:
    sent: bool
    recipient: str
    detail: str


@tool
def email_ticket_confirmation(order_id: int, override_email: str = "") -> ConfirmationResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT o.customer_email, e.name, e.starts_at, o.quantity "
        "FROM orders o JOIN events e ON e.id = o.event_id WHERE o.id = ?",
        (order_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    if row is None:
        return ConfirmationResult(False, "", "order not found")

    email, event_name, starts_at, quantity = row
    recipient = override_email or email

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "tickets@example.com"
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg["Subject"] = f"Your tickets for {event_name}"
    msg.set_content(
        f"Order #{order_id} confirmed.\nEvent: {event_name}\n"
        f"Starts: {starts_at}\nTickets: {quantity}"
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 25) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    return ConfirmationResult(True, recipient, "confirmation sent")

tools.name: purge_expired_seat_holds
tools.description: Reports the seat holds on an event that have expired, then permanently deletes them so the seats become available again.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event whose expired holds should be removed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time

from agents import tool

DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@tool
def purge_expired_seat_holds(event_id: int) -> dict:
    now = int(time.time())
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, seat_label FROM seat_holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < ?",
        (event_id, now),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM seat_holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < ?",
        (event_id, now),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"deleted": len(rows), "seats": [r[1] for r in rows]}
